overview: The Council approved a standard compensation ordinance for contractors and salary adjustments for several director positions. The body also discussed infrastructure projects and local licenses before tabling the FY2027 budget and related appropriations for further review.

items.title: Meeting Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved records from several May and June meetings as amended and reports from the Committee of the Whole regarding FY2027 budget meetings.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance (Paper 25189)
items.summary: Approved on third reading an ordinance establishing a wage floor and benefits for contracted janitorial and security services. The Council rejected an administration request for further delay, adopting minor amendments regarding enforcement powers and prevailing wage exclusions.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments (Paper 26084)
items.summary: Approved on third reading salary adjustments for the Directors of Elections, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, and Veteran Services. Despite administration concerns regarding internal equity, the Council maintained amendments to align the positions within the same classification grade based on a third-party study.

items.title: Grant of Location: National Grid (Paper 26108)
items.summary: Approved a grant of location for National Grid to install an underground electric conduit between 3960 and 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: Extended Hours: Scoopology LLC (Paper 26109)
items.summary: Approved an amendment to Coldstone Creamery's license to allow operations until 1 a.m. daily during the summer season. The approval includes a 21-day review period to monitor potential noise impacts on nearby apartments.

items.title: MBTA Bus Network Redesign Resolution (Paper 26110)
items.summary: Approved a resolution to conduct public outreach and solicit resident feedback on proposed MBTA bus route changes affecting the Hillside and West Medford areas.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board Reappointment (Paper 26111)
items.summary: Approved the reappointment of Lisa Ann Davidson as chair of the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board.

items.title: Food Truck Permits: Medford Square Fest (Paper 26112)
items.summary: Approved a food truck permit for June 13th but tabled requests for later summer dates to allow for further discussion with local brick-and-mortar business owners.

items.title: Water Main Replacement Appropriation (Paper 26113)
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $5.5 million from Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund retained earnings for water main replacements on several city streets. City Engineer Owen Wartella stated the work is part of a long-term plan to address aged infrastructure and low water pressure zones.

items.title: School Stabilization Fund Appropriation (Paper 26114)
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $1,085,549 from the Medford Public Schools Special Purpose Override Stabilization Fund to support teacher contract costs, stipends, and extracurricular programming.

items.title: PEG Access Special Revenue Fund (Paper 26115)
items.summary: Accepted state law to establish a special revenue fund for reserving cable franchise fees to support public, educational, and governmental access services.

items.title: FY2027 Budget Submission (Paper 26061)
items.summary: Tabled the proposed $217 million FY2027 general fund and enterprise budgets until June 23rd. Councilors expressed concern over a lack of transparency regarding legal expenditures and the Mayor's offer to fund specific priorities only if the law department budget remains uncut.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Free Cash (Paper 26105)
items.summary: Tabled an appropriation for the Affordable Housing Trust until the next regular meeting.
